decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint is a core pipeline fitting for utility customers and costs little to keep in the range.
The ceiling or floor pipe bracket uses the firm's existing fabrication capabilities and serves its established plant builder and contractor customers.
The pipe support bracket complements the pipeline component range and fits the firm's strategy of broadening its core offer.
The powder-coated waste bin is far from the core business, but it uses the firm's existing coating equipment and sells to municipal customers it already serves, so it is likely kept for now.

This line of waste bins with ashtrays relies on the same powder-coating and fabrication capabilities and the same municipal channel, which justifies keeping it despite being outside the core business.
The outdoor ashtrays are a niche diversification that is cheap to keep alongside the bins, though their distance from the core business carries some risk of being dropped.
